info.title: LeaseGuard Reports API
info.description: Company-scoped reports computed from verified records, served at /api/v1/reports through the gateway. Read-only: LeaseGuard never collects, processes or facilitates payments. Every report requires the x-company-id header.

company.name: x-company-id
company.description: Active company (workspace) id; the caller must be a member

message.description: Human-readable message, or one message per validation problem

description.example: Properties, occupancy, rental roll and outstanding balances per property.

icon.description: Lucide icon name, resolved by the web app.

PropertyStatus.description: An archived property is listed only while it carries a balance or open events (or when asked for); its units are not in the totals.

status.description: An archived property is listed only while it carries a balance or open events (or when asked for); its units are not in the totals.

monthlyRentalRoll.description: Current monthly rental of the active leases whose terms are verified (ZAR, excl. VAT).

outstanding.description: Outstanding on the latest verified statement of each account at the property (ZAR).

tenantsInArrears.description: Tenants with an outstanding balance at the property.

openEvents.description: Monitoring events still open (new, under review, action required, in progress).

propertyCount.description: Listed properties that are not archived.

unverifiedLeases.description: Leases that have not ended whose terms are not verified yet.

tenantsInArrears.description: Distinct tenants with an outstanding balance.

asOf.description: The South African date the figures are as at.

tenantId.description: The unit's current tenant: its current lease's tenant, else its assigned tenant.

units.description: Every unit counted, of the properties that are not archived.

asOf.description: The South African date the figures are as at.

ageDays.description: Days from the date the event was identified to the "as at" date.

overdue.description: Still open with a due date before the "as at" date.

total.description: Events listed: the open events, or the events of the statuses asked for.

open.description: Listed events still open (new, under review, action required, in progress).

overdue.description: Listed events still open and past their due date.

asOf.description: The South African date the figures are as at.

source.description: `event`: a monitoring event was raised for the statement; `recomputed`: found by recomputation.

current.description: True: the lease's latest verified statement compared with its verified terms now. False: an open discrepancy event on an earlier statement, with the calculation it recorded.

periodStart.description: Start of the billed period: the date the contractual rental is evaluated at.

steps.description: The escalation calculation, step by step.

rows.description: Outside tolerance first, largest difference first.

totalMonthlyDifference.description: Sum of the differences on rows outside tolerance (ZAR).

underBilled.description: Sum of the positive differences outside tolerance (ZAR).

overBilled.description: Sum of the negative differences outside tolerance, as a positive amount (ZAR).

eventCount.description: Rows with a raised monitoring event.

recomputedCount.description: Rows outside tolerance with no event raised yet.

openEventCount.description: Open rental escalation discrepancy events at the listed properties (the dashboard's figure without filters).

leasesCompared.description: Verified, monitored leases compared with their latest verified statement.

awaitingStatement.description: Verified, monitored leases without a verified statement that bills rental yet.

unverifiedLeasesExcluded.description: Leases waiting for verification: their terms drive no monitoring yet.

asOf.description: The South African date the figures are as at.

statementId.description: The latest verified statement of the account, the balance comes from.

outstanding.description: Closing balance, else total due, of that statement (ZAR).

ageDays.description: Days from the statement date to the as-at date.

bucket.description: Ageing bucket label: 'current', a boundary in days ('30') or the open-ended last one ('120+').

underArrangement.description: An active payment arrangement is in force for the tenant; the balance is still owed.

remindersSuppressed.description: That arrangement pauses the tenant's normal arrears reminders.

arrangementId.description: The active arrangement in force (the latest agreed).

ageingBuckets.description: The company's ageing bucket boundaries in days.

asOf.description: The South African date the figures are as at.

outstandingBalance.description: Outstanding balance at the time of agreement (ZAR).

paid.description: Instalments recorded as paid (ZAR); LeaseGuard never takes payments.

overdueCount.description: Open instalments past their due date plus the company's grace days (active arrangements only).

graceDays.description: Grace days after a due date before an instalment counts as overdue.

activeCount.description: Arrangements in force on the as-at date.

outstandingUnderArrangement.description: Remaining balance of the active arrangements (ZAR).

asOf.description: The South African date the figures are as at.

monthlyRental.description: Monthly rental of the leases in the bucket (ZAR, excl. VAT).

daysUntilExpiry.description: Signed calendar days from the as-at date to expiry; negative once expired.

bucket.description: Where the expiry falls in calendar months from the as-at date: expired, within 3 months, 3–6, 6–12, later.

monthlyRental.description: Current contractual monthly rental of the verified lease (ZAR, excl. VAT).

renewalOptionAvailable.description: The lease has a renewal option the tenant has not exercised.

noticeThreshold.description: The company lease-expiry notice threshold (days) reached: the one monitoring raises its expiry event for.

openEventId.description: The open lease-expiry monitoring event of the lease.

buckets.description: Every bucket, in order, with the leases shown in it.

rows.description: Verified leases in a monitored status (active, expiring), soonest expiry first.

expiredCount.description: Leases shown whose expiry date has passed.

withinNoticeCount.description: Leases shown inside a company notice threshold: the leases monitoring raises an expiry event for.

noticeDays.description: The company lease-expiry notice thresholds in days, largest first; empty when the rule is off.

unverifiedLeasesExcluded.description: Leases that have not ended whose terms are not verified: not monitored, so not listed.

asOf.description: The South African date the figures are as at.

noticePeriodMonths.description: Written notice required before expiry, in months.

deadline.description: Last day written renewal notice may be given: expiry less the notice period.

daysUntilDeadline.description: Signed days from the as-at date to the deadline; negative once passed.

warningThreshold.description: The company renewal warning threshold (days) reached: the one monitoring raises its renewal event for.

openEventId.description: The open renewal-notice-deadline monitoring event of the lease.

rows.description: Verified renewal options with a notice period, soonest deadline first.

requiringWarning.description: Leases shown inside a company warning threshold: the leases monitoring raises a renewal event for.

warningDays.description: The company renewal warning thresholds in days, largest first; empty when the rule is off.

missingNoticePeriod.description: Verified leases with an unexercised renewal option but no notice period recorded.

unverifiedLeasesExcluded.description: Leases that have not ended whose terms are not verified: not monitored, so not listed.

asOf.description: The South African date the figures are as at.

GuaranteeExpiryState.description: Released and called are final; else expired once the date has passed, expiring inside a notice threshold, else active.

expectedMonthlyRental.description: Monthly rental the verified terms expect as at the report date, escalations applied (ZAR, excl. VAT).

depositBasisMonths.description: The deposit expressed as months of rental.

depositRequired.description: Basis months × expected rental (ZAR); absent without a deposit basis.

depositShortfall.description: Required deposit less the deposit held, never below zero (ZAR).

guaranteeBasisMonths.description: The guarantee was sized as this many months of rental.

guaranteeRequired.description: Basis months × expected rental (ZAR), for a guarantee recorded as active or expiring.

guaranteeShortfall.description: Required guarantee less the guarantee amount, never below zero (ZAR).

guaranteeState.description: Released and called are final; else expired once the date has passed, expiring inside a notice threshold, else active.

guaranteeDaysUntilExpiry.description: Days from the report date to the guarantee expiry (negative once expired).

needsAttention.description: A deposit or guarantee shortfall, or a guarantee expiring or expired.

totalDeposits.description: Deposits held on the listed leases (ZAR).

totalGuarantees.description: Guarantees in force (active or expiring) on the listed leases (ZAR).

leasesWithShortfall.description: Listed leases with a deposit or a guarantee shortfall.

guaranteeNoticeDays.description: Guarantee expiry notice thresholds in days, largest first.

unverifiedLeasesExcluded.description: Leases with a deposit or guarantee that have not ended but whose terms are not verified: not listed.

asOf.description: The South African date the figures are as at.

pendingReview.description: Status review_required, processing failures included (as the dashboard counts).
Status review_required, processing failures included (as the dashboard counts).

uploadedOn.description: The South African calendar date of the upload (the date range bounds it).

processingFailed.description: Automatic extraction gave up: under review with the reason in processingError.

unresolvedFields.description: Extracted fields a reviewer still has to confirm or correct.

ageDays.description: Whole days from the upload date to the as-at date.

pendingReview.description: Status review_required, processing failures included (as the dashboard counts).

bySource.description: In source order; sources without uploads left out.

oldestPendingReviewDays.description: Age in days of the oldest statement waiting for review.

backlog.description: Waiting for review, processing failures included, oldest upload first.

failures.description: Automatic processing failed, oldest upload first.

asOf.description: The South African date the figures are as at.
